mapper.sql: id, family_id, owner_member_id, name, asset_type, holder_member_id, holder_member_name, acquire_date, current_value, valued_at, next_inspect_date, remark, deleted, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_asset (id, family_id, owner_member_id, name, asset_type, holder_member_id, holder_member_name, acquire_date, current_value, valued_at, next_inspect_date, remark) VALUES (#{id}, #{familyId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{name}, #{assetType}, #{holderMemberId}, #{holderMemberName}, #{acquireDate}, #{currentValue}, #{valuedAt}, #{nextInspectDate}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM archive_asset WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE archive_asset SET name = #{name}, asset_type = #{assetType}, holder_member_id = #{holderMemberId}, holder_member_name = #{holderMemberName}, acquire_date = #{acquireDate}, current_value = #{currentValue}, valued_at = #{valuedAt}, next_inspect_date = #{nextInspectDate}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE archive_asset SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT asset_type AS assetType, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(current_value, 0)), 0) AS totalValue, COUNT(*) AS count FROM archive_asset WHERE deleted = 0 AND owner_member_id = #{ownerMemberId} GROUP BY asset_type
